heading: Withdrawal of certain public lands for classification; revocation of Executive Order Numbered 5237
lead: The objectives of Executive Order Numbered 5237, dated December 10, 1929, which withdraw certain public lands for classification, having been accomplished by the enactment of this subchapter, that Executive order is hereby revoked effective as of the date the Secretary establishes the area.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Executive Order Numbered 5237, dated December 10, 1929, referred to in text, is not classified to the Code.
